newsitem.title: USA: Paxson sells Global options on 2 stations.
newsitem.headline: Paxson sells Global options on 2 stations.

text.p: Paxson Communications Corp said on Thursday it agreed to sell to Global Broadcasting Systems Inc its options to acquire WNGM-TV in Atlanta for $50.0 million and WOAC-TV in Cleveland for $23.5 million.
Paxson said it operates WNGM and WOAC and holds options to buy both from Whitehead Media Inc for a total of $17.6 million.
The deal leaves Paxson with 45 television stations nationwide, including other stations serving the Atlanta and Cleveland markets.
Paxson said it would receive a total of $73.5 million from Global for its options.
Paxson shares closed up 3/8 to 10-1/4 on Thursday.
